{{short description|German mathematician}}
'''Gunter Malle''' (born 13 May 1960 in [[Karlsruhe]])<ref>Kürschner's Scholar's Calendar 2009</ref> is a German mathematician, specializing in [[group theory]], [[representation theory]] of finite groups, and [[number theory]].
[[File: Malle gunter.jpg | thumb|Malle at [[Oberwolfach]], 2006]]
Malle received his doctorate in 1986 from [[Karlsruhe Institute of Technology]] under the supervision of Heinrich Matzat with the thesis ''Exceptional groups of Lie type as Galois groups''.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=57694|title=Gunter Martin Malle}}</ref> He completed his habilitation in 1991 at [[Heidelberg University]] and from 1998 was a professor at Kassel University. Since 2005 he has been a professor at the [[University of Kaiserslautern|''Technische Universität Kaiserslautern'']].

Malle does research on linear algebraic groups, finite groups of Lie type and local-global conjectures in finite-group representation theory, ''e.g.'' [[Brauer's Height Zero Conjecture]],<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Kessar|first1=Radha|last2=Malle|first2=Gunter|title=Quasi-isolated blocks and Brauer's height zero conjecture|doi=10.4007/annals.2013.178.1.6 |journal=[[Annals of Mathematics]] |volume=178 |date=2013|pages=321-384|arxiv=1112.2642}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|author=Malle, Gunter|author2=Navarro, Gabriel|author3= Schaeffer Fry, A. A.|author4=Tiep, Pham Huu|title=Brauer's Height Zero Conjecture|year=2024|doi=10.4007/annals.2024.200.2.4  |volume=200 |journal=[[Annals of Mathematics]] |pages=557-608|arxiv=2209.04736}}</ref> the [[Jonathan Lazare Alperin|Alperin]] weight conjecture, and the [[John McKay (mathematician)|McKay]] conjecture and its block-wise version known as the Alperin-McKay conjecture.<ref>{{cite journal|author=Malle, Gunter|title=On the inductive Alperin–McKay and Alperin weight conjecture for groups with abelian Sylow subgroups|journal=Journal of Algebra|volume=397|year=2014|pages=190–208|url=http://www.mathematik.uni-kl.de/~malle/download/indAMAWC.pdf|doi=10.1016/j.jalgebra.2013.09.013|doi-access=free}}</ref> Malle's research also deals with the [[Henri Cohen (number theorist)|Cohen]]-[[Hendrik Lenstra|Lenstra]] heuristic of the structure of class groups of quadratic number fields in algebraic number theory, the asymptotic distribution of Galois groups of number fields, and with the inverse problem of Galois theory.

In 1993 he began a collaboration with [[Michel Broué]] and Jean Michel concerning Spetses (named after the [[Spetses|Greek island Σπέτσες]] where the program was initiated). The starting point was the question of whether every finite complex reflection group is a Weyl group of an object analogous to a finite group of Lie type. They baptized the unknown, yet to be constructed, objects Spetses.

[[File: Malle broue michel.jpg | thumb|left | Malle (left), Michel Broué, Jean Michel, Oberwolfach 2004]]
In 1998, he was an Invited Speaker with talk ''Spetses'' at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in [[Berlin]].<ref>{{cite book|author=Malle, Gunter|chapter=Spetses|title=International Congress of Mathematicians, Berlin, 1998 August 18–27|volume=II|pages=87–96|chapter-url=https://www.elibm.org/ft/10011644000}} "report on the properties of unipotent degrees of complex reflection groups"</ref>

In 1994 he received the Alexander von Humboldt Research Award for Franco-German scientific cooperation.

==Selected publications==

* with [[Gabriel Navarro Ortega|Gabriel Navarro]], A. Schaeffer Fry, and P. H. Tiep: '' Brauer's height zero conjecture '', Annals of Mathematics, Vol. 200, 2024, pp.&nbsp;557–608
* with Olivier Dudas: '' Modular irreducibility of cuspidal unipotent characters '', Invent. Math., Vol. 211, 2018, pp.&nbsp;579–589 {{doi|10.1007/s00222-017-0753-1}}
* with Britta Späth: '' Characters of odd degree '', Annals of Mathematics, Vol. 184, 2016, pp.&nbsp;869–908 {{JSTOR|44072032}}
* with Caroline Lassueur and Elisabeth Schulte: '' Simple endotrivial modules for quasi-simple groups '', J. reine angew. Math., Volume 712, 2016, pp.&nbsp;141–174 {{doi|10.1515/crelle-2013-0100}}
* with Michel Broué and Jean Michel: Split Spetses for primitive reflection groups. Société mathématique de France, 2014. [https://arxiv.org/abs/1204.5846 arXiv preprint]
* with [[Radha Kessar]]: '' Quasi-isolated blocks and Brauer's height zero conjecture '', Annals of Mathematics, Vol. 178, 2013, pp.&nbsp;321–384 {{JSTOR|23470826}}
* with [[Robert Guralnick]]: "Products of conjugacy classes and fixed point spaces", J. Amer. Math. Soc., Vol. 25, 2012, pp.&nbsp;77–121 {{doi|10.1090/S0894-0347-2011-00709-1}}
* with [[Donna Testerman]]: [https://books.google.com/books/about/Linear_Algebraic_Groups_and_Finite_Group.html?id=4l52zICEq3EC '' Linear algebraic groups and Finite Groups of Lie Type''], Cambridge University Press 2011
* with [[Martin Isaacs|Marty Isaacs]] and [[Gabriel Navarro Ortega|Gabriel Navarro]]: ''A reduction theorem for the McKay conjecture'', Invent. Math., Vol. 170, 2007, pp.&nbsp;33–101 {{doi|10.1007/s00222-007-0057-y}}
* with Jürgen Klüners: ''Counting nilpotent Galois extensions'', J. reine angew. Math., Vol. 572, 2004, p.&nbsp;1–26 {{doi|10.1515/crll.2004.050}}
* with Heinrich Matzat: [https://books.google.com/books/about/Inverse_Galois_Theory.html?id=oVw0L_cR0i0C ''Inverse Galois Theory''], Springer Verlag 1999
* with Michel Broué and [[Raphaël Rouquier]]: [https://www.math.ucla.edu/~rouquier/papers/brmaro.pdf ''Complex reflection groups, braid groups, Hecke algebras''], J. reine angew. Math., Vol. 500, 1998, pp.&nbsp;127–190
* with Michel Broué and Jean Michel: ''Représentations unipotentes génériques et blocs des groupes réductifs finis'', Société Mathématique de France, 1993 (with appendix by [[George Lusztig]])
* ''Exceptional groups of Lie type as Galois groups'', J. reine angew. Math., Vol. 392, 1988, pp.&nbsp;70–109 {{doi|10.1515/crll.1988.392.70}}
